Independently corroborated by reading src/physics/layer2/estimate_store.py's own _PK = (year, gp_name, session_type, constructor) -- the sibling store's natural key ALSO omits round_idx, confirming this is an established, already-precedented convention, not an invented-for-this-gate claim.
